content.short: Time Shifters powered by Heuristic Labs.
content.description:
Heuristic Labs is a company based in Baltic States which focuses on bringing the simulation of human intelligence processes by machines, especially computer systems into NFT space.

We're glad to announce our first CNFT project ''Time Shifters''. A unique generative art collection with the utility never seen in NFT space!

We provide a completely functional AI generator software that doesn't require any coding; all you have to do is submit a text prompt, and the app's AI will turn your words into masterpieces. Our app focuses on the ability to generate AI art using an initial image & allowing the AI model to have a base for the creation! You'll be able to stake ''Time Shifters" NFTs to generate tokens which will allow you to use software to generate your own art. Create a breathtaking and stunning images which you can use for your own NFT projects.
